messages:
Marta: Follow-up from the postmortem: we need clear owners, hard due dates, and exact runbook snippets. Keeping things lightweight.
Samir: i'll take the cache warm automation and the canary hook. plan: a runnable CLI with dry-run and rollback. target: 2026-04-04.
Elaine: adding concise triage steps to put directly in the runbook. paste-ready:
- Confirm incident signature: `rli logs query --service=inference --last=10m --grep="eviction|OOM"`
- Check node capacity: `rli nodes list --region=us-west2 --format=table`
- KV eviction check: `rli metrics query --name=kv_evictions_rate --window=5m`
- If eviction > 0.8 -> run cache warm (example):
```
# warm KV cache
rli cache warm --model=redwood-alpha-1 --keys-file=/tmp/seed_keys.txt --concurrency=6
```
- If 3 warm attempts fail -> escalate per matrix.
Nora: i'll own the runbook update + a short playbook checklist. drafting a focused appendix with exact expected outputs (so responders can quickly verify success). i'll aim to have draft by 2026-03-30.
DevOps: will add a Grafana panel for kv_evictions_rate and two alerts: advisory at 0.6 (trend) and page at 0.9 (sustained 2m). also adding `p99_seq_len` advisory rule.
Priya: from the retro, a recurring pattern is long-tail sequences causing memory pressure. propose an automated advisory that suggests scaling the model pool before paging. i can prototype a small lambda that checks p99_seq_len vs baseline and emits advisory events. target: 2026-04-01.
Oncall Bot: PD rule PD-RULE-82 updated: if primary oncall does not acknowledge within 5m -> escalate to eng-lead. bot will post the matrix in #incidents tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Marta: Owner & due date summary for action tracker:
- Samir: cache-warm automation + canary integration (due 2026-04-04)
- Nora: runbook + playbook checklist + appendix (draft 2026-03-30)
- DevOps: grafana panels + alert rules (due 2026-03-27)
- Priya: seq-len advisory prototype (due 2026-04-01)
- Platform: confirm PD escalation config (owner: Platform Team, status: pending)
Samir: note: automation will include a `--dry-run` and `--undo` flag. i'll post PR and link it here when ready.
Nora: PR created for runbook edits: https://git.redwood/internal/runbooks/pulls/482 - pls leave quick thumbs or inline comments.
Elaine: small addendum: add a command to switch to fallback model variant before doing infra rollback: `rli model route set --variant=alpha-quant --timeout=20s` and validate with `rli model status --model=alpha-quant`.
DevOps: i'll wire up the advisory logic: if p99_seq_len advisory AND kv_evictions_rate > 0.75 -> promote to page. i'll also add the runbook note linking these signals.
Marta: quick check: can we include expected command outputs in the appendix? e.g. snippet showing `rli cache warm` reporting success lines. makes oncall verification faster.
Nora: yes. appendix will include example outputs, exit codes to check, and a short checklist: "warm succeeded -> observe evictions drop < 0.3 within 10m".
Priya: one more item: add a short test in CI that runs a lightweight warm-cache smoke test against staging on every canary deploy so we catch regressions early.
Marta: great. i'll collate PR links and close the retro follow-ups once owners confirm their PRs/alerts are merged this week. please ping here when done. :thumbsup:
